conclusions.dominant_glucose_route: glucose -> G6P -> F6P -> non-oxidative PPP -> Ru5P -> RuBP (PRUK) -> RUBISCO(carboxylase) or RUBISCOX(oxygenase) -> 3PG -> 2PG -> PEP -> pyruvate -> acetyl-CoA
conclusions.first_bottleneck: F6P is routed to non-oxidative PPP, not PFK/FDP; GAPD1/PGK never carry glycolytic flux
conclusions.rubisco_dependence: model requires the RuBP carboxylase/oxygenase system (RUBISCO or RUBISCOX); closing BOTH makes glucose unusable (growth 0)
conclusions.co2_forced_artifact: RUBISCO KO + forced CO2 uptake (-2.0) is infeasible because CO2 has no sink
